name: Kouro Tomomi
source:
Tomomi is an aspiring artist who would be in college studying architecture and landscape design right now if not for a certain incident.

She's always had a pretty low tolerance for nonsense, but recent events have left her especially irritable. But at heart she's serious and responsible, and has a knack for reading people when she puts her mind to it.

Her hobbies are painting scenery and listening to indie music.

(from [url=https://dialoguelostloop.tumblr.com/refinery]official tumblr[/url])
